_about: Cost catalogue for the demo effort estimator. Unit = hours of the builder's active work in the chat (agent runs in between are not counted), plugin era. Seed prices were set by expert judgement and scaled by calibrate.py on internal history; your own records in ledger.csv refit them. Edit prices here, then rerun calibrate.py.

base.what: stand check, package, branding, reading the script, handover capsule

use_case.what: per use case: rehearsal, fixes after the run, ClickPass share

new_object.what: new object with section and list/form pages

extended_object.what: columns on a stock object (replacing schema)

page.what: new or heavily customised Freedom UI page / modal

studio_agent.what: AI Studio agent incl. publish, bind, test

studio_tool.what: MCP tool / process tool for Studio

custom_component.what: anything not out of the box: custom JS/remote module, tree grid, kanban, PDF viewer

integration.what: external channel or API: telephony, WhatsApp, voice, file parsing

second_language.what: a second UI/data language; RTL adds rtl_extra

risks._about: Adders in mentor hours, plus calendar days that do not add work (waiting).

cloned_or_donor_stand.what: stand copied from another demo: donor leftovers, shared Ids

shared_stand_other_builders.what: colleagues edit the same stand at the same time

compile_needs_approval.what: shared instance, compile/restart only with approval

inherited_build.what: someone else's build to audit first

studio_first_on_stand.what: first AI Studio agent on this stand: OAuth, technical user, credits

mobile_offline_scan.what: mobile offline mode, barcode scan, real device rehearsal

script_draft_not_final.what: script still changing, questions to the SE

eras._about: Multiplier on build hours by tooling era. team = helper sessions / subagents in parallel: a prior until real team-mode demos are recorded. pre-plugin = fitted on internal history.

calendar._about: Turning hours into days. Filled by calibrate.py from the ledger. co_builder_calendar_factor: a second builder on the stand shortens calendar days, not total hours.
